test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 17 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech.

Mona said to me, “Are you planning a trip to Disneyland?”

options.text: Mona enquired of me if I was planning a trip to Disneyland
Mona asked me that was I planning a trip to Disneyland?
Mona enquired of me that was I planning a trip to Disneyland.
Mona asked me if I had been planning a trip to Disneyland?

solution:
The correct answer is"Mona enquired of me if I was planning a trip to Disneyland".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given direct speech is of Present Continuous Tense**(Subject+be verb(am/is/are)+doverb+ing+object).**
 
• So after the speech change, it will be Past continuous tense**(Subject+be verb(was, were)+do verb+ing+object)**.
 
• And also the subject and verb interchange the position as it is an interrogative Sentence.
 
• Here one linker is added that is 'if'.
 
• Hence the indirect speech is: *Mona enquired of me if I was planning a trip to Disneyland.* 

The correct answer is ***option(1)***.
